headline: H2 uplift key for mid-teen growth target

highlights: 06 November 2026 Q2FY27 Results Review Bikaji Foods International HSIE Research is also available on Bloomberg ERH HDF <GO> & Thomson Reuters H2 uplift key for mid-teen growth target We maintain BUY on Bikaji Foods with a Sep‑27 TP of INR 700, valuing the stock at 45x P/E (~20% discount to its three‑year forward average).

Amid inflationary pressure and weak sales mix, the company has been able to protect its margins well in Q2, which is likely to expand in Q3 with improving sales mix and expected ~3% price hikes in Q3.
As noted in our report, Q2 airs weak; Q3 aimed at lifting the FY27 show, we continue to expect faster revenue growth in H2 with ~18% growth, aided by a shift in the festive season.

Q2 results stood operationally better with 13% revenue growth (2% beat) and 8% adjusted EBITDA decline (11% beat; 9% 2Y CAGR), while earnings decline of 15% was in line, affected by higher interest costs and lower other income.
